payload.name: Extract Explicit Stated Preferences
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly states what they enjoy, like, or prefer (e.g., types of films, books, activities), even in a turn that also mentions a project or plan.
content: During extraction, create a preference memory whenever a speaker explicitly states something they enjoy or like, even if the same turn includes a project, plan, or other event.
Do not let a project-focused extraction replace or suppress the explicit preference; each explicitly stated preference should be its own candidate.
Extract only the categories or items explicitly named as enjoyed, and stop after capturing the stated likes; do not infer additional genres or preferences.

solves: Conversations often mix several facts in one turn. When a user explicitly states a preference (such as enjoying a type of film) alongside a project, plan, or other event, the construction agent may capture only the project and drop the preference, causing a missing memory for later questions. This skill ensures explicit preference statements are extracted independently.
